name: Image to Code
description: Translates authorized screenshots or visual references into a functional responsive implementation.
constraints: Use only user-provided or authorized visual references.
Do not infer hidden interactions, assets, text or responsive states as facts; label necessary implementation assumptions.
Match visual structure without reproducing protected brand assets unless the user supplied or authorized them.
guidance: Inspect every reference before coding and inventory layout, hierarchy, type, color, spacing, radius, imagery, components and visible states.
Derive a compact design token set and component structure before implementing the full screen.
Preserve the target project's stack and existing conventions unless the user explicitly requests a change.
Implement responsive behavior from design intent rather than scaling the screenshot as one fixed canvas.
Compare the implementation against the references, then repair the largest structural and visual differences first.
completion_checks: All supplied references were inspected and their visible states were accounted for.
The implementation is functional, semantic and responsive rather than a static image replica.
Typography, hierarchy, spacing, color and component geometry are coherently matched.
Assumed content or behavior is explicitly distinguishable from observed facts.
No inaccessible image-only control or unauthorized protected asset remains.
